facts.claim: The Government educational institutions of Coorg in 1875-76 included the Mercara Central School with Canarese and Hindustani branches, which had 348 pupils, 230 of whom were Coorgs.
facts.quote: The Government educational institutions of Coorg in 1875 — 76, comprised the Mercara Central School, with Canarese and Hindustani branches attached, containing altogether 348 pupils, of whom 230 were Ooorgs ;

facts.claim: There were 84 schools in the Province with 2,739 pupils, about one in 61 of the population.
facts.quote: Adding all together, there were 84 schools in the Province with 2,739 pupils or 1 in 61 of the population.

facts.claim: One Coorg studied law at Cambridge in England but returned and died of consumption.
facts.quote: One Coorg went to England to study law at Cam- bridge, but shortly returned in a consumption, of which he died.
